# Revision Notes — v1.4

## Added

- Restored all 34 Universal homeworld races from the supplied concordance.
- Restored all 26 preserved Alien-Folk profiles from the same source, for 60 total races.
- Added all 22 full deity dossiers and all 22 WEBP portraits.
- Added all 106 homeworld race-deity association links.
- Added race, bloodline/form, and deity-association fields to the character schema.
- Added book appendices for homeworld races, Alien-Folk, and full deity dossiers.
- Added online and board-game bridge rules for race and deity cards.

## Clarified

- Race provides physiology and fictional permissions/limits, not fixed ability-score bonuses or mandatory behavior.
- Public deity associations are cultural and religious, not compulsory worship or sole biological ownership.
- Alien-Folk remain outside the Universalian deity assignment index because the supplied assignment source explicitly excludes them.
- Exclusive terraforming responsibility remains separate from race habitat and patronage.

## Preserved

All 22 classes, 132 paths, Class Evolution Point rules, eight alignment axes, phase/slot gradients, and 81 named alignment profiles remain unchanged.
